Home/Our Company/What is roaming?
WHAT IS ROAMING?

Away from home.
Still connected.

Roaming lets a mobile device use a visited network outside the coverage of its home network.

↓
ROAMING, EXPLAINED

A journey in three connections.

01

The home network

Your operator holds your subscription. Abroad, your device looks for an available visited network.

02

The visited network

A local network provides voice, SMS and data under roaming arrangements with your home operator.

03

The link between them

Signalling, data links and commercial agreements allow both networks to exchange information and account for usage.

BEHIND THE CONNECTION

Where Comfone comes in.

Comfone provides interconnections between operators. The Key2roam Platform brings together network connectivity, hubbing, clearing and data intelligence.
